text: Program Description Details of Degree Program GCM (Global Communication and Management) Undergraduate Program The GCM bachelor program is committed to training entrepreneurs and future business leaders who combine interdisciplinary knowledge, expertise in financial and business analysis, and a deep understanding of China's business environment. Students will graduate with bilingual proficiency in Chinese and English, cross-cultural communication skills and a solid foundation of knowledge about China. They will be able to succeed in multinational corporations and Chinese enterprises in the fields of management, business, communications and marketing.
